name: Tokurun! 2: Toku Date
source:
Tokumei and Valerie are surprised with a double date by their friend Todd, where Tokumei unexpectedly meets someone from his past. 

[From [url=https://rentry.co/snootmods#i-wani-hug-that-gator]Snoot Game Mods List[/url]]
